question.text: A survey of the opinions of students [^shows|show] that the majority are very satisfied with our online language courses.
question.modelAnswerString: A survey of the opinions of students shows that the majority are very satisfied with our online language courses.

question.text: What gave me the idea for the novel [^was|were] a story that one of my children told me.
question.modelAnswerString: What gave me the idea for the novel was a story that one of my children told me.

question.text: The decline in sales of new cars during the recent period of economic difficulty [^has|have] hit the company hard.
question.modelAnswerString: The decline in sales of new cars during the recent period of economic difficulty has hit the company hard.

question.text: What remains of the Roman temple today [is|^are] small sections of the outer wall.
question.modelAnswerString: What remains of the Roman temple today are small sections of the outer wall.

question.text: Whatever attacked her as she walked through the jungle [^was|were] scared off as we arrived in the clearing.
question.modelAnswerString: Whatever attacked her as she walked through the jungle was scared off as we arrived in the clearing.

question.text: What I really like about the town [^is|are] the main square.
question.modelAnswerString: What I really like about the town is the main square.

question.text: The streets nearest to the town centre [is|^are] to be closed to traffic during the weekend.
question.modelAnswerString: The streets nearest to the town centre are to be closed to traffic during the weekend.

question.text: The next round of meetings between the countries in the trading organisation [^takes|take] place in six months' time.
question.modelAnswerString: The next round of meetings between the countries in the trading organisation takes place in six months' time.

question.text: What interests researchers at the Institute of Technology [is|^are] the potential applications of newly-invented plastics.
question.modelAnswerString: What interests researchers at the Institute of Technology are the potential applications of newly-invented plastics.

question.text: That the attack was part of some co-ordinated plot to destabilise the government now [^seems|seem] certain.
question.modelAnswerString: That the attack was part of some co-ordinated plot to destabilise the government now seems certain.
